closed_concerns.evidence: Cycle-safe cause/context classifier and independent direct/subclass/wrapped/implicit/cyclic checks pass; actual sealed PairedGeometryError main mocks retain original/geometry receipts and correctly distinguish resource from nonresource errors.

concerns.title: Caught candidate-forward allocator failures bypass the outer classifier

evidence.detail: The observed closure rethrows after storing failed-call type/message but does not persist resource classification.
Candidate exceptions are caught and stored as per-member type/message records while the grid continues.
A returned helper failure becomes joint_failure; returned slices permit installations, without checking observed allocator failures.

concerns.reproduction: Exact observer and candidate try/except AST snippets, executed with stdlib mocks only, swallow direct MemoryError and opaque RuntimeError with MemoryError cause. Both charge one failed observed call, append None, and retain no classifier result or cause in returned string records.
concerns.impact: A candidate OOM can lead to joint_failure or later native_paired_source_qualified rather than resource_deferred. Allocator causes of opaque wrappers cannot be recovered from current recorded strings.
concerns.requested_correction: Classify and persist allocator information while the live exception exists in the observed closure; after helper return, check that sentinel/receipt before installation or success. Preserve all paired trials/counters and emit resource_deferred when allocator exhaustion occurred. Test both joint-failure and apparent-later-acceptance returns plus nonresource failures in a separately sealed version.

concerns.title: Topology receipt saves a seed and permutation hash rather than the vector

evidence.detail: Topology seed/hash/equality are retained; the vector is not persisted.

concerns.suggested_correction: Save the unlabeled permutation vector in the new run receipt to directly fulfill the sealed paired caller's saved-permutation instruction.
